Behind him is a screen displaying a silhouette of an elephant underwater. The man shares his aspirations to become a professional photographer, describing his father's initial disapproval, complete with an imitation of his British accent and classic professor attire—a tweed jacket with leather details and a bow tie. There's a shift in the scene to an art gallery where he, now wearing a black suit jacket, is engaged in a conversation with a man in a suit and a woman, both presumably gallery patrons, as the artist gestures towards the artwork. The lighting in the gallery is soft, highlighting the artwork displayed on the walls. The scene then transitions back to the man against the background with the underwater elephant silhouette, as he recounts his father's eventual conditional approval—to get a degree in anything but photography. His expression indicates a blend of amusement and respect as he shares this memory.
